worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (person 0) 61,500.00 + long-term gains 40,000.00 = 101,500.00. Federal taxable income = 101,500.00 - standard deduction 31,500.00 = 70,000.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Filing status married filing jointly, no Montana standard deduction or exemptions. Schedule I Part I: line 7 additions 0.00; line 24 subtractions 0.00. Form 2 page 1: line 1 federal AGI 101,500.00; line 2 Form 1040 lines 12e and 13b 31,500.00; line 3 70,000.00; line 4 0.00; line 5 0.00; line 6 age 65 subtraction 0 x 5,660.00 = 0.00; line 7 Montana taxable income 70,000.00 + 0.00 - 0.00 - 0.00 = 70,000.00. Page 2 worksheet: line 1 70,000.00; line 2 net long-term gains 40,000.00; line 3 lesser 40,000.00; line 4 ordinary income 70,000.00 - 40,000.00 = 30,000.00; line 5 42,200.00; line 6 42,200.00 - 30,000.00 = 12,200.00; line 7 lesser of lines 3 and 6 = 12,200.00; line 8 3% x 12,200.00 = 366.00; line 9 40,000.00 - 12,200.00 = 27,800.00; line 10 4.1% x 27,800.00 = 1,139.80; line 11 366.00 + 1,139.80 = 1,505.80; line 12 ordinary income tax on 30,000.00: 4.7% x 30,000.00 = 1,410.00; line 13 1,505.80 + 1,410.00 = 2,915.80, carried to page 1 line 8. Bracket schedule as numbers (the expected figure): 4.7% x 42,200.00 = 1,983.40; 5.9% x (70,000.00 - 42,200.00 = 27,800.00) = 1,640.20; bracket tax 3,623.60. Gains limited to taxable income: lesser of 40,000.00 and 70,000.00 = 40,000.00; extra rate -1.8% x 40,000.00 = -720.00; 3,623.60 - 720.00 = 2,903.60. Line 9 nonrefundable credits 0.00; line 10 tax after credits 2,903.60. The form gives 2,915.80; expected keeps the projection's 2,903.60, a difference of 12.20 from 3% against 2.9% on the 12,200.00 of gains inside the first bracket, 12.20.
accepted_approximations: Montana taxes long-term gains at two rates, and the format holds one extra rate. Gains run through the ordinary brackets on top of ordinary income and pay an extra rate of -0.018 (4.1% less 5.9%). That is exact for gains above the first bracket, and gives 2.9% where the booklet says 3% for gains inside it. The gains must be limited to taxable income first (Form 2 page 2 line 3).
